dish: Chōju-zen longevity set (≈15 small dishes of Yanbaru island vegetables, by reservation)
n: Emi no Mise, Ōgimi (笑味の店)
w: Opened in 1990 by Kinjō Shōko to pass on the food culture of Ōgimi, the 'longevity village'; a farm restaurant whose reservation-only chōju-zen longevity set is built on seasonal island vegetables she grows herself. Her book of Yanbaru grandmothers' kitchen wisdom was published in 2023 (Ryukyu Shimpo).

dish: Ganso beni-imo tart (purple sweet-potato tart; hand-making experience)
n: Okashi Goten Onna (御菓子御殿 恩納店)
address: Onna-son, Kunigami-gun, Okinawa, Japan (coastal Route 58; red-gated palace-style shop)
w: The red-gated seaside flagship of the confectioner behind the 'original' beni-imo tart, made from 100% Okinawan purple sweet potato from contracted farmers with no preservatives or colouring; the baking line is visible through glass and a reservation-only tart-making class runs here.

dish: Mozuku soba (homemade noodles kneaded with organic Ōjima-coast mozuku seaweed)
n: Mozuku Soba Kunnatu, Nanjō (もずくそばの店 くんなとぅ)
w: Facing Ōjima, a mozuku-farming centre, this shop kneads JAS-organic mozuku into its own soba noodles and serves them in a light bonito broth with tempura fried to order.
